narrative.text:
On October 8, 2024, at approximately 1645 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a gas station in Adrian, Michigan, after the subject approached the marked patrol vehicle to ask for directions to a nearby farm. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] identified himself and asked the subject where he was from. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and admitted that he had no papers to be in the United States.
The subject said that this is not his first time in the United States. In 2014 he was caught by Border Patrol agents shortly after crossing near Eagle Pass, Texas, and was voluntarily returned to Piedras Negras the same day.
He stated that he crossed again on foot near Eagle Pass on 03/18/2015 and has worked on farms in Ohio and Michigan since then.
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
The subject was processed for a Warrant of Arrest and Notice to Appear.
